mission: Authorize deterministic, operator-triggered intermediate application progression inside the managed Playwright Chrome lane only, stopping at final operator review without automatic terminal commits.

relationship_to_session_contract.invariant: This contract does not amend or weaken the MV3 extension session v1 forbidden_actions auto_submit and click_next_or_continue. Extension-side automatic navigation remains prohibited.
relationship_to_session_contract.read_only_observer_note: The optional MV3 submission observer grants observation and same-path reinjection only, never terminal click authority. It does not change managed final_action_activated_always_false.

relationship_to_navigation_authority.note: Classification remains pure and evidence-bound. Activation is permitted only after prepareToFinalReview re-inspects and the managed driver rebinds the exact control fingerprints.

preparation_states.REVIEW_READY: Trusted terminal control observed; operator must perform final submission personally.
preparation_states.REVIEW_REQUIRED: Unresolved fields, validation errors, manual gates, missing uploads, or unauthorized intermediate action; operator decides.
preparation_states.BLOCKED: Origin/session mismatch, loop, exhausted budget, or non-deterministic preparation; fail closed.
